{{Quote|This is your hrrtayyk.&raquo;<br />&laquo;I am ready.|translated=1|[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] during the rescue of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>}}
The '''hrrtayyk ceremony''', also known as the '''Test of Ascension'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|65|Hrrtayyk}}</ref> or '''Rite of Passage''',<ref name="FF12">{{FactFile|12|WOO 1-4|Wookiees}}</ref> was the coming-of-age ceremony among the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], occurring usually around the age of twelve which unlocked a young Wookiee's [[rrakktorr]]. In [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], it translated to ''Test of Ascension''. In hrrtayyk ceremonies, the Wookiees learned to survive in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], learning such survival techniques as how to avoid predators; how to make rope, tents, and utensils from various plants and plant products; the location of [[freshwater spring]]s; and which plants and insects were edible, and which were poisonous. They would also engage in ritual hunts of various predators, such as the [[Katarn/Legends|katarn]]. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] hrrtayyk ceremony was in [[187 BBY]], when he was thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.<ref name="CSWE" />

The [[Syren plant/Legends|Syren plant]] would often play a role in this ceremony, and other similar ceremonies in certain regions of the planet.
